delivery.label: Nationwide
delivery.note: Two to three working days anywhere in Ghana

faqs.a: Accra orders are dispatched the same working day and usually arrive within 24 hours. Elsewhere in Ghana, allow two to three working days.

faqs.q: Can you help me find my foundation shade?
faqs.a: Yes — message us on WhatsApp with a photo of your face in natural daylight (no filter) and the shade you currently wear in any other brand. We will match you against what is in stock.

Every item is sourced directly from the brand or its authorised distributor and batch-verified before it reaches our shelves. If anything is ever found not to be genuine, we replace it or refund you in full.
Unopened items in original packaging can be returned within seven days. For hygiene reasons opened cosmetics cannot be returned unless the product is faulty.
